items.title: Deal or No Deal, AstraZeneca Stock Is a Bargain
items.summary: Few big-pharma bosses enjoy a stronger reputation on Wall Street than  AstraZeneca’s  chief executive,  Pascal Soriot.  After plunging on a Financial Times report of merger discussions with  Bristol-Myers Squibb  shares of AstraZeneca recovered somewhat when Reuters reported there are no ongoing talks.  After rebuffing  Pfizer’s  $120 billion takeover bid in 2014, he steadily transformed AstraZeneca into one of the drug industry’s top growth stories.

items.title: What the AstraZeneca-BMS rumors reveal about pharma megamergers
items.summary: Reports of talks were quickly disputed, but the prospect exposed the appeal — and antitrust risks — of combining two pharma giants.
